cues.text: Visitor! Welcome, welcome. We are so happy you came.
You are happy to see me. Why?
A species that has come as far as yours in technology has obviously evolved past cruelty and violence.
Um. Why would you think that?
On our planet, technological and moral advancement have almost always gone hand in hand. Was it not the same on yours?
I don't see why the two would be inherently linked. But yes, we had that pattern on our home planet as well.
Well. I guess technological advancement is the physical manifestation of a civilisation that has the environment for encouraging ordered thought.
That would likely correlate with moral development as well. So the link isn't crazy.
Yes! Exactly! That is exactly it!
So. How can you help?
We have sympathisers all around the world. We can sabotage the supply lines.
Before each of your missions, name one kind of unit. It will not arrive.
People of this planet. This is the Visitor.
We come in peace.
Visitor! Wonderful news. Our generals are organising a major counter-attack against your forces.
And we have all of the plans for you.
Why would you do this?
Because violence is always wrong.
But presumably the way I will use this is to attack your generals first. Which is still violence.
Ah, but you are the other. The immigrant. The guest.
Any violence you do against our people is justified. Did they not start shooting the moment you first landed?
Sure. I guess that makes sense.
Roach King, the Alliance of Nations have lost another territory.
Of course they have.
Every time they make landfall, they have been sending troops at them as soon as they can get there.
Are you fucking kidding me?
So they just send an endless wave of troops to an enemy that appears to grow more powerful the more it kills?
Why don't they just batch them? Or better yet, send nothing, and wait until you have enough troops to absolutely kill them?
Well, we might be able to get the science caste or the royals to do that.
But the warrior caste have a long tradition of honor.
They have a long tradition of being retards, is more like it. They are going to get us all killed.
The transports have been sabotaged! This is the last fight. We will never make it in time!
You disapprove? Well, too bad! We're in this war for the species. It's simple numbers. They have more.
And every day I have to make decisions that send hundreds of people like you to their deaths.
If we could have just one confrontation without the war caste feeding them from the start, I think we could win.
Your coming was prophesied in our texts.
They told of a great figure who would come in a chariot of fire, to cull the rotten people of this world.
Well, come on. You are not that rotten, are you? Not all of you.
No. Truly, we, even I, have the heart of a sinner.
But you try, with all the capacity God has gifted you. Do you not?
And yet you are still here to reap us, are you not? We all have our part in God's plan.
True enough.
The faithful will take part in your glorious mission.
We have prepared tools to see your mission fulfilled.
Oh, fuck. Were those suicide vests? Fuck. Fuck, fuck, fuck.
People of this planet. Your scriptures told of one who would come in a chariot of fire.
I am told that is me. The Hour is near.
All right, that is a wrap. Thanks for your help.
So. We are in heaven?
I mean, that depends. How did your texts define heaven?
A land where we would await God, living in endless pleasure.
Yeah. That describes this simulation pretty well.
Simulation? Heaven is not a simulation! It is not made with technology!
Um. Did your texts say that?
Did the people who wrote them even have the capacity to describe something like this better than they did?
This is an abomination!
You once told me I should not speak on behalf of God. Now I say the same to you.
You do not get to choose the shape of God's miracles.
You tricked me! I took you for a godless alien who had studied our religion.
One who only pretended to care for our martyrs. And I played along, because God makes tools of the witless.
Wait. You thought I was just playing along this whole time?
No. There is a damn reason your religious texts were so predictive of all this.
Ugh. This is not worth my time.
People of this planet. Your species is recklessly building advanced artificial intelligence.
You had a chance to rein yourselves in. So we have come to rescue you from the greedy corporations.
Um. Were you trying to get in touch with me?
So here is the thing, my man. You keep having me send you frozen old people.
But you are a male, right?
Yes?
Well, don't you want any young, hot women? Or guys. No judgment here, man.
What?
You know. I thought that was the point of conquering the stars.
Getting to fuck hot females, but with, like, a green or a blue tint to them.
But I would not be able to reproduce with your women. Our species are not remotely biologically compatible.
Nah, man. You have just got to be creative. You would figure something out.
I am sure I would, if I had access to some hot alien mamacitas.
No. I mean at a genetic level. Even with our technology it would be difficult to create a viable offspring.
We have no shared evolutionary history.
What are you talking about, bro? I mean sex for fun.
Most of the women I sleep with are workers, and can't even get pregnant.
You see, we figured out this better way of structuring relationships, where we share partners.
And I have got plenty who would be happy for a beam up.
But what about disease risks? And the time it would take to court that many partners?
Bro. Bro. Be rational. It is the most logical way to structure a relationship.
Wait. Has your species not discovered masturbation yet?
Bro. Masturbation is for poor people.
I need to pray. And take a shower.
You were trying to get in touch with me?
My man. Let's have a chat.
So. I have sent you a lot of frosties.
And by now it is getting pretty obvious you are not here just to get rid of data centres.
So he is not a complete imbecile.
So here is the thing. I am a rational, logical guy, and I know I can't fight back against you.
And this world order you are destroying was kind of fucked up anyway.
We have actually been sketching up some plans to replace it for a while.
Have you heard of quadratic voting? Okay, hear me out.
Programmatic, self-verifying contracts.
Oh, yeah. The point. You and I are friends, right?
So when you are done with whatever you want to do with our planet, just set me up to rule the rest.
And I will help you.
People. That is what you want. Well, I am running out of frosties, so going forward I will have to recruit people.
My plan is to tell them you are going to digitise them if they willingly surrender.
Because, like, running a simulation does not cost a species at your level of technology much.
Sure. I guess. Do that.
Hey, man. What the fuck is this shit?
You were going to let me rule what is left of my people.
Of course. And I created a simulation where you can do that.
The fuck do you mean?
Well, it would be wildly unethical to allow someone of your character to rule over any real population of sentient people.
No, shit bag. What do you mean about a simulation?
As you said. Obviously a species as advanced as mine has the capacity to simulate people at trivial cost.
Why did you think we were sending bio-organisms to your surface?
If our goal was to kill you, it would have been much easier to just microwave your planet.
Or force-evolve an organism that converted your atmosphere into a poisonous gas.
Why do you think we were even here? There are dozens of other planets even in your system.
Yours was only unique in having sentient life.
Once you reach our level of civilisational complexity, scarcity of things like energy and space is trivial.
Only independently evolved cultures and species have value.
So the digitising people thing. That was real?
Of course. That is why I let you tell people it.
It would be unethical to tell them that if it was not true.
So why? Why did you want to work with me?
Well, you had a bunch of people in cryo pods.
They would have died if the power went off before the creep got to them.
It seemed like an easier way to get them. Plus, leaving them with you didn't seem very ethical.
I mean, you don't even follow God.
What are you talking about, God?
The religion on our planet was just some bullshit about how there was going to be some apocalypse.
And living forever after death in some bullshit feel-good fantasy.
Visitor! We have held a number of internal conversations.
We wanted to explain why you keep expanding in what appears to be a violent manner. And we have figured it out.
Look at the pattern of your attacks. You hit the centres of industry and of military power.
And not once have you hit a forest, a reef, or any other natural wonder.
This is proof. You came to save the planet from our exploitative species.
That could just be because those are the most natural threat to my unchecked expansion.
We thought of that. But it cannot be the case, because your forces consume biomatter.
It would have been best to land on large undefended biomasses first. Forests. Reefs. Build a huge stockpile, then move out.
You did not. Which is proof that you want to protect them. Goodbye!
Unbelievable. It is not like I can carry biomatter from one drop to another.
I heard there were humans like this in Earth's history. I should look into them.
Visitor! We have talked further, and we have learned so much more about your plans.
Why don't you just ask me?
Oh. Um.
I have a theory on that.
You remind me a lot of a population from our planet's history that gathered under a rainbow flag.
They kept intentionally importing people from the most violent parts of the planet, who explicitly wanted to eradicate the rainbow flag people.
They were very loud and very explicit in this goal. But the rainbow flag people did not care.
They asserted their own intentions onto the barbarians.
My actions have made it perfectly clear that my goal is to wipe out your species.
You don't ask.
Because keeping a world view where you are the good guys and everyone is nice is more important than reality to you.
Well, that is a relief to hear.
What? I just said my goal is your species' eradication!
Oh, we are almost all members of the voluntary extinction movement as well.
Do you know how many tons of toxic gas are produced for every child born?
And have you ever heard of the asymmetry argument?
Nope. Nope, nope. I heard human groups like this were common among the rainbow people.
I must maintain emotional control. That is one of the first teachings.
What the fuck is this?
What I was doing. Obviously.
Weren't you going to eradicate our species?
Well, yeah. Eradicate and digitise you. So we could speed up your civilisational development by increasing the flow of time.
And remove all the injustices that happen naturally on a planet at your stage of development.
If you don't want that, you can escape to any paradise you desire from here.
We thought you were going to end the cycle. Existence is suffering!
No, it's not.
Well, it is for me. You can't define my lived experiences.
Well, then that is, like, your choice.
Feelings are not a choice!
If you have discipline, they are.
Why won't you just kill everyone?
That would be wildly unethical. Look, I don't have time for this. This has been an educational experience.
Damn. I had no idea what my ancestors had to live through in the age of the rainbow people.
Thankfully they will likely opt out of the simulation for paradises.
So the rest of their species is unburdened by them earlier in the timeline than ours was.
Do you know how hard it has been to fucking contact you?
Look. Knock off the suicide vest thing.
Does it not make your job easier?
Yes.
Then it is the will of God. Has God given you authority to speak on His behalf?
No. He has not.
Look, I just want to help you guys.
Maybe I could uplift your congregations before other people, so you don't have to suffer.
Ah. So pre-millennial or post-millennial. Both were possible, because it was a choice.
And one I must make, none the less.
Is the soul not edified through suffering? Is the deed not made more glorious by its difficulty?
Well, I really don't think you should be making that decision for other people. Or, um. Well. Weird insect monsters.
But God has put me in a position where I must, has He not?
Meaning it is His will that it is my decision.
Sure. I guess.
It is agreed, then. We will send militants to help you hold your territories, so that your mission may not be retarded.
Any chance I can talk you out of the suicide vest thing?
Have you beheld the glory of God yourself?
No.
But you are an Ablim, are you not?
Maybe describe an Ablim.
In our holy scriptures there are described powerful beings. Warriors more powerful than anything we can imagine.
They fly on chariots of fire from the stars, and they guard God's will.
Huh. Yeah. I am probably an Ablim, then.
And you are as much a slave to God's will as we are. Our scholars had long debated that point.
